style.styleTitle: Personalised Couple's Foiled Wreath Engagement Christmas Bauble by No Ordinary Gift
style.toneOfVoice: An intricate glass bauble featuring a metallic foiled, illustrated wreath design. The illustrated wreath surrounds the personalised text and features the word “Engaged!”, which is included in the design as standard, making this a perfect gift for any newly engaged couple. Below the word “Engaged!” is space for 2 lines of personalised text, ideal for customising with the couple’s names and their engagement date. The design is printed in a metallic foil onto a clear polyester sheet, inserted into the bauble, which is finished with a grosgrain hanging ribbon in a choice of colours. The bauble measures approximately 8 x 8cm.
